observations: Multiple stacks of used tires in a warehouse setting.
Photos show mixed tire sizes/fitments (some appear like passenger/van tires; others look like larger tires), but exact size markings are not readable.
Tread patterns are visible; some tires show uneven wear/age but overall condition cannot be quantified from these angles.
No clear brand/model names are readable on the tire sidewalls in the provided photos.
Seller watermark text appears on images, but it does not confirm tire origin/brand.

claims.evidence: No Belgium origin, brand, or DOT/manufacturing details are readable on the tire sidewalls in photos 0-2.

risks.risk: Exact tire size/load rating/speed rating is not readable, so the wrong category could be priced.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of each tire sidewall showing the full marking (e.g., something like 205/55R16 91V) and DOT code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed used tires with unknown size and unknown ratings (worst-case: lower-grade/less desirable fitment).

risks.risk: Brand/model is not readable; could be low-demand brands or mismatched sets.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sidewall brand/model text for at least 2 tires (front and one from a different stack).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used tires (worst-case: no premium brand).

risks.risk: Condition (tread depth, sidewall cracks, repairs/patches) cannot be confirmed from these wide shots.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of tread surface and sidewall (including any cracks/repairs) plus a tread-depth measurement photo (or a gauge reading).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified condition (worst-case: moderate wear and possible minor defects).

risks.risk: Quantity/assortment is unclear (how many of each size).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full count per size (or a list) with each size clearly labeled.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an assortment with uncertain quantities (worst-case: smaller usable quantities per size).

proof_requests: For each tire size you want to sell: a close-up sidewall photo showing the full tire code (width/aspect/rim), load index, speed rating, and DOT date.
A close-up photo of tread depth (ideally with a gauge reading) and sidewall condition (cracks/repairs).
A photo/list showing how many pieces of each size are available.
response.reason: The photos confirm used tires are present, but the key details needed to price correctly (exact size/ratings, brand/model, and condition) are not readable. Without those, any price would be guesswork.
